verdict.rationale: Deepgram Voice Agent lets the agent take actions during a live call, but this is not a rules engine. Function calling has the LLM describe an action that your own application then executes (deepgram-docs-2, deepgram-docs-20). Multi-agent handoffs are triggered by context or intent (deepgram-docs-3), and InjectAgentMessage lets your app make the agent speak mid-call (deepgram-docs-11). missing for 10: a declarative rule or trigger definition system, event-based automation that runs without custom application code, any documented event catalog or rule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
